name: Samira
source:
As the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Banu_Haqim]Banu Haqim[/url] representative, Samira is sure to have some interesting things to say about the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Lasombra]Lasombra[/url] clan joining the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Camarilla_(VTM)]Camarilla[/url]. 

She sees a bit of a potential kindred spirit in [url=/c91993]Julia[/url], perhaps an ally at some point... if only the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Neonate]neonate[/url] would show some actual interest in politics instead of seemingly wasting her time. 

Samira is in close contact with [url=/c93357]Hellene Panhard[/url]. There is no friendship between the two, but she enjoys having the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Prince_(VTM)]Prince's[/url] ear, and is worried that weak leadership might disrupt the local Camarilla - it's not like there's an obvious candidate for Princedom other than some [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Primogen_(VTM)]Primogen[/url], perhaps. Samira has very limited trust in them, though.

[Edited from the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1405990/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Shadows_of_New_York_Artbook]Artbook[/url]]
